title: Research: bound PR1154 packing headroom
body:
## Result

Adds `research/pr1154-packing-relaxation/`, a source-pinned upper bound on
packing-only improvement for PR1154's adaptive rank-seven T16 word. This is a
candidate-specific use of the selected-word ceiling, not a new construction
or selected-kappa update.

The frozen complete profile minus PR1154's idle histogram gives the exact
aggregate local profile over 144 calls. The standard 73-rank, 896-family,
nine-stage, centre-64 relaxation with idle ranks at most 51 gives

```text
421850048701/250000000000000 <= a* <= 337480038961/200000000000000
kappa <= a*/(1+a*) <= 0.001684557671861340916...
```

PR1154's reported `kappa=0.001673260706543984` is 99.3293809% of this cap.
The unchanged selected bit-side saving is above the required complex saving,
so the complex side still binds for this comparison.

## Scope and overlap

The card's selected-word and staged544/T488 packing domains have current
coverage. The live queue-ceiling census #2762 explicitly left PR1154
unscreened, and the refreshed #1166 comments and open-PR search showed no
current matching PR1154 packing claim. This package uses PR1154's pinned
aggregate local profile; it does not claim an attained packing optimum.

The bound allows fractional idle placement at rank 51 and covers all
repackings of this fixed aggregate local profile under the stated model. It
does not cover changed local words, templates, port counts, coverage laws,
centre charges or outer recipes. PR1154 remains partially reviewed. The
source owner-audit and exact-price receipts are hash-checked, but the underlying
owner/native replay and full supplier admission were not rerun.

## Verification

- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` —
  `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` at selected-record hash
  `bb2eaa58647b353f88d0aec2eafb9d30df1be53589231b23e12ceef3e4bad129`.
- `python3 -B research/pr1154-packing-relaxation/verify.py --write` —
  `PASS_PR1154_AGGREGATE_PACKING_RELAXATION`.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr1154-packing-relaxation --check-only` —
  `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr1154-packing-relaxation` —
  `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE outcome=partial`.

Credit: PR1154 (Dugongue), PR1117, PR1111 and the retained T16 lineage. The
ceiling method is from `research/complex-local-word-ceiling/` (Douglas Colkitt
with Claude assistance). Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr1154-packing-relaxation`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
